blocks.text: 2.8 cm wavelength wale microwave equipment (Fig. 15.6) se interference pattern dekha ja sakta hai. Microwave transmitter (waves bhejne wala aala) metal ki deewar mein bane do gaps (double gap, do khaali jagahein) ki taraf rakha jata hai. Microwaves dono gaps par diffract hoti hain (mur kar phailti hain) aur aage wale hisse mein phail jati hain, jahan probe receiver (waves pakarne wala aala) unhein pakarta hai. Probe ko idhar udhar hilane se high intensity (zyada taqat, constructive interference) aur low intensity (kam taqat, destructive interference) wali jagahein milti hain. Probe ko meter se jora ja sakta hai, ya audio amplifier aur loudspeaker se, taake result awaz ki shakal mein suna ja sake.

blocks.alt: Tirchhi nazar se dekhi hui lab ki bench. Aage left par stand par rakha microwave transmitter (dabba) hai jo taron se left kinare wale power unit se jura hai; yeh teen khari metal sheets ki taraf hai jo L shape ke pairon par khari hain aur un ke darmiyan do tang gaps hain. Sheets ke peeche stand par microwave probe hai jo taron se right side wale meter se jura hai.
